definitions.full: H6925. qodam קֳדָם 42 preposition before (so Old Aramaic, Nabataean, Palmyrene, etc. (Lzb 360f. ), קָדָם ᵑ7 , Syriac ; properly a substantive the front , compare Arabic the front ; for √ see Biblical Hebrew קדם ); — suffix קָדָמַי Dan 2:9 +, מָ֑י - 2:6 ; קדמיך Kt, קֳדָמָךְ Qr, 5:23 ; 6:23 ; קֳדָמוֺהִי 4:5 + (compare Nerab קדמוה , Cooke 189 ); 3 feminine singular קדמיה Kt, קֳדָמַהּ Qr, 7:7-8 , 20 ; קֳדָמֵיהוֺן 4:4 ; — 1 before (= Hebrew לפְנֵי ), especially in the phrases to answer, pray, say, etc., before a superior (as more respectful than to ), Dan 2:9 קֳדָמַי לְמֵאמַד , 2:10 ; 2:11 ; 2:27 ; 6:11 (see Dr), 6:12 ; 6:13 ; 6:14 ; ק ׳קֱרִי Ezra 4:18 ; 4:23 ; Ezra 5:23 (twice in verse); with שְׁפַר to seem fair Daniel 3:32; Dan 6:2 ; after verbs of motion, in before , 2:24-25 , 3:13 ; 4:3 +; of time 7:7 . 2 מִןקֳֿדָם from before ( = מִלִּפְנֵי , but as used in late Hebrew, Est 1:19 ; 4:8 ), with קַבֵּל Dan 2:6 , בְּעָא 2:18 ; of a decree, 6:27 טְעֵם שִֹׁים מִןקֳֿדָמִי (|| מִנִּי 3:29 +), compare 2:15 ; Ezra 7:14 ; of God, Dan 5:24 דַּייְֿדָא מַּסָּא שְׁלִיחַ מִןקֳֿדָמוֺהִי , 7:10 (so very often in ᵑ7 , Dr Sm lxx. f. lxxiii). Also = Hebrew מִמְּנֵי , with to fear 5:19 ; 6:27 , be rooted up 7:8 , fall 7:20 .
